parameters.content:
## LI-02 | Lead SLA Monitor | V1

HubSpot is the source of truth. Contact = person; Deal = enquiry.

LI-02 reads delivered Deals that are AWAITING_RESPONSE, evaluates the first qualifying response, and updates only SLA response fields. LI-01 continues to own intake, Contact resolution, Deal creation, association, delivery, owner assignment, and SLA initialization.

V1 SLA is 30 calendar minutes: deadline = lead_received_at + 30 minutes. No separate due_at property is used.

## Qualifying human response

Only Deal-associated activity attributed to the assigned Deal owner is considered.

- Email: direction EMAIL, valid hs_timestamp at or after lead_received_at, and status not BOUNCED, FAILED, SCHEDULED, or SENDING. SENT, null, and empty status are allowed.
- Call: hs_call_status = COMPLETED with a valid timestamp at or after lead_received_at.
- Meeting: valid hs_meeting_start_time or hs_timestamp at or after lead_received_at, and outcome not CANCELED, CANCELLED, NO_SHOW, RESCHEDULED, or SCHEDULED. COMPLETED, null, and empty outcome are allowed.

The earliest valid UTC timestamp wins.

Live portal findings: valid outbound CRM email may return hs_email_status = null, and a valid logged meeting may return hs_meeting_outcome = null. V1 excludes explicit non-sent/non-completed states rather than requiring SENT or COMPLETED.

Limitation: HubSpot email metadata does not always prove whether an owner-attributed outbound CRM email was manually sent rather than automated. Validate this per client portal.

## Deploy safely

The workflow and its 5-minute schedule remain inactive. Bind every HTTP node to the existing HubSpot Service Key account credential, then run manual controlled tests before enabling the schedule.

Required scopes: Deals read/write plus email, call, and meeting activity read access.

V1 intentionally excludes notifications, escalations, reassignment, reminders, AI scoring, priority tiers, business-hours/holiday/timezone logic, availability calendars, queues, external state stores, and LI-99 integration.

Repeated/overlapping runs are deterministic: only AWAITING_RESPONSE Deals are selected and updates set the same final values.
